name: Go To Market
description: Go-to-market fleet — product-market-fit diagnosis, prospect research, copy, outreach, and closing skills, plus multi-channel publishing through the Postiz agents CLI.

skills.name: gtm-scout
skills.description: Research and qualify B2B prospects, accounts, and buying signals.

skills.name: gtm-writer
skills.description: Write cold emails, LinkedIn posts, and follow-up copy that gets replies.

skills.name: gtm-rep
skills.description: Run outreach: emails, call and voicemail scripts, objection handling, sequences.

skills.name: gtm-closer
skills.description: Proposals, negotiation, pricing, competitive deals, and stalled-deal recovery.

skills.name: gtm-mission-control
skills.description: Spawn and coordinate a multi-agent GTM team (scout/writer/rep/closer) on one objective.

skills.name: gtm-pmf-doctor
skills.description: Diagnose product-market fit: symptom check, one binding bottleneck, one falsifiable experiment.

skills.name: gtm-market-fit-canvas
skills.description: Fill and stress-test the nine-block Market Fit Canvas, then name the weakest link in the chain.
